messages:
maria: Quick 15m sync in 20m — need a clear go/no-go for GA of Burst Autoscale. We must align on SLA wording, public docs, support paging, monitoring thresholds, and the pricing SKU. If you have a hard blocker, flag it here now.
aj: I'm on. Couple clarifying points before the meeting: do we hold the overall p99 latency target at 350ms for GA? Also finance asked if we can present a simple two-SKU pricing option this week.
sam: 350ms p99 target remains for single-shard normal flow. For burst we need an explicit degraded-mode plan otherwise p99 will blow out. My proposal: automatic single-shard fallback + degraded-response header + short degraded-token budget. Runbook draft below.
```
Runbook: BurstAutoscale
- Trigger: queue_depth >= 40 sustained for 45s
- Immediate action: divert new inflight requests to single-shard serving pool
- Response contract: HTTP 200, header `X-Instance-Mode: degraded`, body unchanged
- Billing: mark requests as `degraded=true` for post-processed billing adjustments
- Alerting: fire SEV when degraded_rate > 4% over 5m; page on >10% sustained for 10m
- Automated rollback: if degraded_rate > 12% for 10m, rollback to stable model config
```
lisa: I can own the public-facing docs and changelog. Need exact header name/value and the billing flag key from Sam so I can show the curl examples and the sample invoice breakdown.
kevin: Support needs clarity on paging. Recommend infra-oncall for infra-level regressions. Product-oncall should get paged for customer-impacting degraded incidents (degraded_rate > 5%) and any SLA violations. I'll add a short FAQ for customers about behavioral expectations and cost impact.
aj: For pricing, finance wants two SKUs: "Burst Standard" (pay-as-you-go) and "Burst Reserved" (committed capacity). Proposed add-on: 10% premium on tokens served in degraded-mode to reflect extra overhead. Is Legal okay with the premium being applied only to degraded-tagged tokens?
maria: That pricing approach is acceptable in principle. We must include a clear billing example in docs (e.g., 1k tokens normal @ $X vs 1k tokens with 200 degraded tokens @ premium). No surprise billing.
sam: Monitoring action items: create metric `burst.degraded_rate` (ratio of degraded-tagged tokens to total). Add dashboard panel and SLO alert rules. I'll instrument tags and emit `burst.degraded_rate` in staging deploy. Also will add a trace span annotation for degraded responses.
lisa: Docs plan: public changelog entry + /docs/burst-autoscale page with: how it works, header examples, billing example, troubleshooting table, and oncall contact matrix. I'll wait on the exact header and billing flag values from Sam.
kevin: I'll update our runbook escalation matrix: infra first for infra regressions, product for customer-facing degradations, and exec paging for SLA breaches. Also prepping templated customer comms for if we need to opt customers into Reserved Burst.
maria: Owners and immediate deliverables before the 20-minute sync: 1) sam: confirm header key (`X-Instance-Mode`) and billing flag key and finalize rollback thresholds — due in 45m; 2) lisa: draft docs + billing example once header confirmed — due EOD; 3) kevin: update oncall routing & escalation matrix and draft FAQ — due 3h; 4) aj: finalize SKU wording with finance/legal and post copy — due EOD. If any blocker prevents those timelines call it out now.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy scheduled in 30m to validate metric tagging and degraded_rate emission: https://ci.internal/reports/4892 (pipeline 4892).
maria: If no hard objections posted here we will proceed to ship the GA checklist to execs after the sync. Drop approvals or callouts inline if you can't make the meeting. :white_check_mark:
